title: Function-first bottle contact-maintenance requirements

requirements.requirement: A named physical mechanism or accepted deterministic architecture must own establishment and maintenance of the required lateral bottle contacts.
The maintenance mechanism must define an entry/open condition, a capture/closed condition, and a release/open condition with explicit motion type, usable travel/range, and limits.
The mechanism must maintain an equivalent rank-sufficient lateral normal-contact set throughout CAPTURE_AND_ROTATION, LABEL_TRANSFER_INTERVAL, and WRAP_ACTIVE rather than only at one static pose.
The mechanism must state how bottle and positioning variation are accommodated by compliance, force-controlled actuation, controlled motion, or another explicit contact-maintenance law.
Normal contact reactions and closure reactions must have an explicit structural path to fixed support/mounting geometry.
Contact maintenance must preserve the verified bottle rotation_wrap_axis as an intentionally available motion during the wrap interval.
Any tangential traction used to drive bottle rotation must be explicitly bound separately from the normal-force closure geometry.

Open/closed limits and reachable motion must be checked against bottle entry, label-transfer geometry, release, neighboring products, CAB hardware, and mounting structure before mechanical acceptance.

explicitly_not_established: No mechanism family is selected by this requirement model.
No force, stiffness, preload, travel, friction, timing, or interval-wide maintenance value is inferred.
The current V43 geometry is not promoted from fit-check/candidate evidence to mechanically accepted mechanism geometry.
